verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs mention an internal 'agent' that reads user feedback submissions and automatically fills in intentions and proposes tasks (foreloop-docs-10, foreloop-docs-21), which is a limited form of AI delegation. However, this is a narrow, single-purpose automation tied to the feedback-collection pipeline, not a general-purpose built-in assistant that users can converse with or delegate arbitrary tasks to. Missing for 10: evidence of a conversational/general AI assistant, ability to delegate arbitrary tasks beyond feedback-to-task conversion, and any interface for direct task delegation by the user. [2026-09-24 adversarial bias audit (depth-spike lane): reverted partial 5 -> partial 4 — quality bump rested on the same one-sentence claim; posture unchanged. Ultrametric-affiliation governance, README §9.]
